BCCT.description: Boundary Change Assignment to Load Cases/Analysis (BCCT). A single-instance table: bool flags select which boundary categories are affected, vBOUNDARY defines named boundary group combinations, and vLOADANAL assigns each load case / analysis type to one of those combinations (or leaves it Unchanged).

bSPT.description: Include Support in the boundary change set.

bSPR.description: Include Point Spring Support in the boundary change set.

bGSPR.description: Include General Spring Support in the boundary change set.

bCGLINK.description: Include Change General Link Property in the boundary change set.

bSSSF.description: Include Section Stiffness Scale Factor in the boundary change set.

bPSSF.description: Include Plate Stiffness Scale Factor in the boundary change set.

bRLS.description: Include Beam End Release in the boundary change set.

bCDOF.description: Constrain DOF associated with specified displacements / settlements by boundary group combinations.

vBOUNDARY.description: Boundary group combination list. Each entry defines one named combination and the boundary groups it contains; combination names must be unique.

BGCNAME.description: Boundary group combination name (referenced by vLOADANAL[].BGCNAME).

vBG.description: Boundary group names that make up this combination; each name must already exist as a boundary group.

vLOADANAL.description: Load cases & analysis assignment list. Each entry maps one load case / analysis TYPE to a boundary group combination (BGCNAME) or leaves it as "Unchanged". Missing analysis types are auto-filled as Unchanged by the handler.

TYPE.description: Load case / analysis type (case-insensitive). ST = static load case (uses LCNAME); ULAT = unlisted analysis types; THRSEV = time history / response spectrum / eigenvalue; THNS = time history nonlinear static; PO = pushover; MV = moving load; SM = settlements.

BGCNAME.description: Boundary group combination name to assign; must match a vBOUNDARY[].BGCNAME, or "Unchanged" to leave the boundary condition unchanged for this type.

LCNAME.description: [TYPE=ST] Static load case name to assign; must reference an existing static load case. Ignored for non-ST types.
